fields.FIR_Description: A online complaint dated 2026-08-28 states that the complainant reported that a boundary wall near Nallur Park Main Street was extended into the land of the complainant without permission, on 2026-08-27 at roughly 09:50. The online submission was made by Uma Raj (9000000089). The complainant alleged that Murugan Sundaram may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000207. Funds were reportedly sent to the account reference SYN-ACC-100099. Udhay Muthu (9000000352), described as an intermediary, was also mentioned in the complaint. A witness, Padmini Sri, reachable on 9000000119, was mentioned in the complaint. Potentially relevant material referenced includes physical documents, a witness statement and photographs. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00356, as the mobile number 9000000207 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Encroachment reportedly began after a dispute over survey records.
